items.source: Create a new ApplicationReadyEvent instance.
items.translation: 创建一个新的ApplicationReadyEvent 实例。

items.source: Return the time taken for the application to be ready to service requests, or null if unknown.
items.translation: 返回应用程序准备就绪以处理请求所需的时间，如果未知则返回 null。

items.source: Event published as late as conceivably possible to indicate that the application is ready to service requests. The source of the event is the SpringApplication itself, but beware of modifying its internal state since all initialization steps will have been completed by then.
items.translation: 事件在最晚可能的时刻发布，以表明应用程序已准备好处理请求。该事件的源是 SpringApplication 本身，但请注意不要修改其内部状态，因为此时所有初始化步骤都已完成。

items.source: context - the context that was being created
timeTaken - the time taken to get the application ready to service requests
items.translation: timeTaken - 应用程序准备就绪以处理请求所需的时间

items.source: the time taken to be ready to service requests
items.translation: 准备处理请求所需的时间

items.source: args - the arguments the application is running with
items.translation: args - 应用程序运行时的参数
